paper_metadata.title: TERMINAL REMISSION IS POSSIBLE IN SOME PATIENTS WITH JUVENILE MYOCLONIC EPILEPSY WITHOUT THERAPY

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study describes the source population and recruitment period clearly. However, as a tertiary referral center, there is a risk of referral bias (more severe cases). The participation rate of eligible individuals is not explicitly stated, making it difficult to rule out selection bias.
